_precisions_note: Every asset named in `markets` needs an entry. A missing one is assumed to have 8 decimals, and where that is wrong the price is signed wrong by a power of ten -- which no signature check downstream can catch. A config that names some and not others is refused at start.
_log_note: Rotate the attestation log past this many bytes (0 never rotates). The closed file's digest is published beside it and seeded into the next file's running hash, so /v1/digest still commits to every attestation ever signed. Rotate ONLY this way: an outside rename or truncate desynchronises the running hash from the file.
_source_note: `max_age` is how long a fetched snapshot may be reused; `feed_max_age` is how old the feed's own _meta.updated may be before this oracle refuses to re-sign its numbers. `type` may also be `http` (one request per market) or `static` (fixed prices, for drills).
_previous_keys_note: x-only keys this oracle used to sign with, published at /v1/pubkey so a borrower's page can tell a rotation from a stranger. A live vault bakes the key it was originated against, so rotation is never a swap.
